# Bar Chart Race

Component ID: bar-chart-race

## Narrative intent

把同口径数值映射成可比较的长度，让观众看出真实大小差距与排序。

Select this recipe only when the current story event needs that audience outcome; the animation alone is not evidence that the outcome was delivered.

## Purpose and selection

- Compare 2–5 non-negative measured values sharing one unit and period.

Do not use:

- Do not use for time-series racing, mixed units, negative values or unverified rankings.

## Supported inputs

- title: Supply real title within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- items: Supply 2–5 entries separated by ",", each with exactly 2 nonempty fields separated by ":". Keep each field within 24 characters. Values must be finite and non-negative, sharing a unit; keep input order consistent with the intended ranking.
- period: Supply real period within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
- source: Supply real source within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.

## Reading order and motion

- Read the metric and period
- Reveal each measured value
- Compare lengths and hold the full ranking

Pattern: data-accumulation. Native default duration: 10s. Minimum final readable hold: 0.7s.

### step-1

- Target: .row:nth-child(1)
- Visible action: Reveal the real value and grow its bar

- inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.
